title: Can I SURVIVE Fog of War?
summary: Chess.com Fog of War vs online humans (~1500): you only see squares your pieces control/can move to; the rest is covered in grey fog. It is king capture (no check warnings). Tony wins game 1 quickly by capturing the king after Qh5 (~2:40), then plays more games, ending with a loss/GG to a well-played opponent (~16:51).
rules: Fog of war: you see only squares your own pieces occupy or can legally move to/attack; enemy pieces elsewhere are hidden.
No check: moving into or leaving the king in 'check' is legal; capturing the enemy king wins (king-capture variant).
After the game the position can be 'defogged'.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king; goal: win one game (achieved in game 1).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board; grey cloud fog over unseen squares (sprite 4EIPARnGSSU_fog_tile.png)

current_impl_issues: Impl 'base:Fog of War' uses checkmate; should be king capture with no check rule.
